name: query
title: query
summary: Find entities (or documents) with the compact query syntax or its JSON form; paginated, returns handles.
html:
Find entities (or documents) with the compact query syntax or its JSON form; paginated, returns handles.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: core
  • MCP: ara_query

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
qCompact query: space-separated terms that must all hold. Light (has the component), !Light (lacks it), name:Crate*, a bare word (radio: names containing it), parent:e_1c0d, under:e_1c0d, prefab:crate, depth<=1, e_8b21 (an ID), field comparisons such as Light.intensity>500, Light.kind=spot, Transform.position.y<=0.
filterThe same conditions as JSON; combined with q.
docDocument (asset ID, path or @path#id); default: every scene and prefab.
kindSearch entities (default) or documents.
fieldsField paths to return per entity (Light.intensity), effective values.
detailPer-item detail: summary (default), handles or full.
limitPage size (default 50, max 500).
cursornext from the previous page.
